name: Arlanza
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Castile and León DO. Allowed grapes include Tempranillo, Garnacha Tinta, Mencía and Cabernet Sauvignon, plus a few whites.
